market_placement.name: Market Placement
market_placement.comment: Close relative to EMA quote-volume/volume holding-cost proxy

path_liquidity.name: Shortest Path Liquidity
path_liquidity.comment: Rolling quote-volume proxy per normalized shortest intrabar price path

spread_proxy.name: Spread Proxy
spread_proxy.comment: Rolling mean log high-low range as an OHLC bid-ask spread proxy

spread_volatility_ratio.name: Spread Volatility Ratio
spread_volatility_ratio.comment: spread_proxy divided by rolling close-return volatility

price_volume_resistance.name: Price Volume Resistance
price_volume_resistance.comment: Price move magnitude per volume move magnitude adapted from PriceVolumeResist

bidask_spread.name: Bid-Ask Spread
bidask_spread.comment: Rolling bid-ask spread estimate from OHLC prices

liquidity_v3.name: Liquidity v3
liquidity_v3.comment: Volume divided by log spread and return volatility proxy

coppock_atr_volume.name: Coppock ATR Volume Composite
coppock_atr_volume.comment: Coppock momentum multiplied by normalized ATR and volume pressure

amihud.name: Amihud
amihud.comment: Amihud illiquidity proxy using intraday shortest price path

corwin_schultz_spread.name: Corwin-Schultz Bid-Ask Spread
corwin_schultz_spread.comment: Corwin-Schultz (2012) 2-day high-low bid-ask spread estimator with VOLUME_LOOKBACK rolling window

roll_spread.name: Roll Effective Spread
roll_spread.comment: Roll (1984) effective bid-ask spread estimator based on serial covariance of price changes

kyles_lambda.name: Kyle's Lambda Price Impact
kyles_lambda.comment: Kyle (1985) lambda regression slope of price return against signed volume over VOLUME_LOOKBACK

amihud_illiq.name: Amihud Illiquidity Ratio
amihud_illiq.comment: Amihud (2002) return-to-dollar-volume illiquidity ratio rolling mean over VOLUME_LOOKBACK

amihud_zscore.name: Amihud Illiquidity Z-Score
amihud_zscore.comment: Rolling Z-score of Amihud illiquidity ratio over VOLUME_LOOKBACK
